name: Jar wine
summary: The jar the museum handbook puts beside the xòe. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names it on the Bản Mòng floor, drunk through the pipes while the xòe is danced. A strength was not printed.
origin: Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, 21 March 2020. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names the jar on the Bản Mòng floor.
howToEat: From the jar, with the evening meal. It is not a morning drink. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Mòng, xã Hua La. A shop price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ruou can in Son La — the jar at Ban Mong
seoDescription: Rượu cần at Bản Mòng, from the jar, with the evening meal and the xòe. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
